verdict.rationale: Greptile supports a versioned `greptile.json` in the repo root. It is read from the PR's source branch and overrides dashboard settings. The docs also mention a strictness setting (1–3) and custom team rules, though the pack does not show either being set in that file. The specific sub-capabilities in the story are not evidenced, so this is only a partial match. Missing for 10: path filters in the config file, per-path instructions, named review profiles, evidence that strictness or custom rules can be set in greptile.json, and independent hands-on corroboration.
